name: secondary_completion
genetic_identity: Secondary completion is the attainment of a recognized lower- or upper-secondary school-leaving milestone by the relevant age cohort — a flow outcome of the schooling system, not mere presence in school.
description: A Concept for judging educational system success by completion of secondary schooling among the relevant age group. Distinct from enrollment (access/participation) and from public spending effort. Grounded against WDI series SE.SEC.CMPT.LO.ZS (primary atom) with related series as supporting context only when envelope allows.

atoms.name: is_outcome_not_access
atoms.statement: Secondary completion is an outcome of schooling — whether the relevant age group finishes a secondary level — not a measure of how many students are currently enrolled.

atoms.name: requires_relevant_age_cohort
atoms.statement: Secondary completion is defined relative to a relevant age cohort for the level completed; rates without cohort denominators are not instances of this concept.

atoms.name: is_country_year_evaluable
atoms.statement: Secondary completion can be evaluated for a country-year when a recognized completion-rate series for that country-year is present and non-null.

atoms.name: has_primary_series_binding
atoms.statement: Within the World Bank WDI envelope, the primary measurable atom binds to lower secondary completion rate, total (% of relevant age group), indicator SE.SEC.CMPT.LO.ZS.

atoms.name: success_is_high_completion_not_high_enrollment
atoms.statement: Success under this concept is high completion of the secondary level by the cohort; high secondary enrollment without completion does not constitute success under this concept.

atoms.name: is_independent_of_expenditure_level
atoms.statement: Secondary completion as an outcome is independent of the level of public education expenditure; spend is a different concept (public education effort).

atoms.name: admits_threshold_fidelity
atoms.statement: Fidelity of an instance can be graded by the completion rate against declared thresholds (e.g. high / moderate / low) without changing the genetic identity of the concept.

rules.name: must_not_use_enrollment_as_proxy
rules.statement: A judgment that uses secondary or tertiary enrollment rates as a proxy for completion has left this concept.

rules.name: must_not_use_spend_as_proxy
rules.statement: A judgment that treats education expenditure (% GDP or % government) as success under this concept has left this concept.

rules.name: null_is_not_failure_of_the_country
rules.statement: A missing completion observation is outside the evaluable envelope for that country-year; it is not scored as low completion.

rules.name: gross_enrollment_over_100_is_not_completion
rules.statement: Gross enrollment rates above 100% (over-age / repeaters) must never be interpreted as completion rates under this concept.

includes: Lower secondary completion rate for the relevant age group (WDI SE.SEC.CMPT.LO.ZS).
Country-year instances with non-null completion observations.
Contrast with enrollment series for breach detection only.
excludes: Secondary enrollment (SE.SEC.ENRR) as a success metric.
Tertiary enrollment (SE.TER.ENRR) as a success metric.
Primary completion alone (SE.PRM.CMPT.ZS) as secondary completion.
Government education expenditure (SE.XPD.*) as outcome success.
GDP per capita as education quality.
Learning proficiency / test scores (not in this panel; different concept).
School construction counts, teacher headcount, or inputs without completion.

holds_within: National aggregates published in WDI for years 2010–2023
Lower secondary completion as primary measure
Cross-country comparison only when completion series is non-null for the same year
breaks_at: Subnational / district grain (use SEDA or national microdata instead)
Upper-secondary-only systems where lower-secondary series is definitionally mismatched
Years or countries with null SE.SEC.CMPT.LO.ZS (not evaluable)

relations.note: Enrollment must not be substituted for completion.
Effort and outcome are joint dimensions of a human-capital CM, not the same concept.

glossary.completion_rate: Share of the relevant age group that completes a stated level of education.
glossary.relevant_age_group: The age cohort used as the denominator for a completion rate series.
glossary.enrollment: Participation in school at a level; not completion.
glossary.fidelity: How well an instance realizes the concept within the envelope (here: completion rate band).
glossary.envelope: Regime of grain, years, and series where the concept's atoms hold.

exemplars.name: france_high_completion
exemplars.description: France with non-null SE.SEC.CMPT.LO.ZS near or above 90 in recent years illustrates in-envelope high fidelity without using enrollment.

exemplars.name: enrollment_completion_gap
exemplars.description: A country-year with secondary enrollment >> lower-secondary completion shows why enrollment cannot proxy this concept; the case is evaluable on completion and flags out-of-kind analysis if enrollment is used as success.
